candidates.title: Recovery Evidence Is Not Replay Authority
candidates.title_zh: 恢复证据，不是重放授权
candidates.researchQuestion: 当认证或人工批准中断工具调用时，智能体运行时应如何保存恢复证据，同时阻止在外部影响仍不确定时静默重放？
candidates.coreProposition: An interrupted tool call should preserve recovery evidence, execution authority, and effect evidence as separate state dimensions; a later authentication or approval event may restore authority but must not silently authorize replay while the prior external effect remains unknown.

sections.heading: Two Fixes Guard Different Interruption Boundaries
sections.heading_zh: 两项修复守住了不同的中断边界

sections.heading: Recovery Information Does Not Grant Execution Authority
sections.heading_zh: 知道如何恢复，不等于有权执行

sections.heading: Renewed Authority Does Not Resolve the First Effect
sections.heading_zh: 重新取得权限，仍未回答第一次调用发生了什么

sections.heading: One Occurrence, Three Independent Evidence Dimensions
sections.heading_zh: 三类证据需要同一发生身份，但不能合并

sections.heading: Replay Safety Should Not Become Blanket Blocking
sections.heading_zh: 安全边界不应变成无条件阻断

evidenceClaims.claim: OpenAI Codex preserves one or more MCP authentication challenges after bounded silent OAuth recovery fails and returns a failed tool-call result without automatically replaying the rejected call in that branch.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: OpenAI Codex 在有限的 OAuth 静默恢复失败后保留一个或多个 MCP 认证挑战，并返回失败工具调用结果，而不会在该分支自动重放被拒绝的调用。

evidenceClaims.claim: Google ADK sets skip_summarization when an MCP tool pauses for confirmation, preventing the pause result from re-entering the model loop and triggering another invocation.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Google ADK 在 MCP 工具等待确认时设置跳过摘要标记，防止暂停结果重新进入模型循环并触发另一次调用。

evidenceClaims.claim: The two implementations suppress autonomous replay at different interruption boundaries while preserving recovery information.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本次比较观察到，两项实现在不同中断边界阻止自主重放，同时保留恢复所需信息。

evidenceClaims.claim: Governed runtimes should model recovery evidence, resume or execution authority, and effect evidence as separate state dimensions under a stable occurrence identity.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，受治理的运行时应在稳定的调用发生身份下，分别建模恢复证据、继续执行权限与外部影响证据。
